architecture.scanner: characters, Unicode/XID, trivia, strings, interpolation modes, numeric transactionality and longest-match compound tokens
architecture.dpg: source roots, structural token order, parser entry shapes and explicit delegation points
architecture.parser_context: contextual words, owner admission, commitment, attachment, source role and boundary policy
architecture.pratt: expression, type and unit parse goals, binding power, associativity, stop sets and parselet registration
architecture.cst_recovery: lossless trivia and bytes, recovery nodes, synchronization and stable source ownership
architecture.ast_checker: normalization, name/type/effect/ownership/coherence rules and semantic rejection
architecture.layering_law: the DPG does not re-expand scanner, Pratt, recovery or semantic-checker contracts and none of those layers may silently expand the accepted source language

critical_surface_invariants: preview source requires exactly one leading PreviewGate
ordinary calls admit a parenthesized trailing comma; tilde argument sequences do not
:~ is one longest-match attached scanner outcome and : ~ is not an actor-message operator
defer admits ~ message cleanup but excludes :~ and trailing closures
parameter form and separator admission is owner-contextual
assignee roots remain structural and exclude nested nominal assignees
mutable-list insert/remove suffix sets remain exactly 4 and 5
expression, predicate, slice-index, type, non-function-type and unit Pratt goals remain closed
recovery residue produces no canonical AST or HIR node
